reading_level_proxy.note: proxies only: shorter sentences and shorter words usually read easier; they do not measure comprehension

ci_method: Wilson 95% for proportions; percentile bootstrap (2000, seed 20261122) for means

human_rating.rating_scale: clarity 1 (unclear) to 5 (very clear); would you know what to do: yes/no

not_evaluated_yet.reason: comprehension and clarity need a native-speaker rating; none is recorded in this artifact

pairing_note: label/reason pairing is illustrative (by rule effect or signal polarity), not an observed verdict
provenance: shipped Arabic catalog templates (not model output)
scope: Arabic verdict text: 30-item native-speaker rating sheet + automated phone-fit and reading-level checks

system_under_test.note: the cascade and Sentinel runs behind this artifact were taken on this commit (origin/main when the jobs started); main moved on afterwards and the model runs were not repeated. The offline parts (no model) were recomputed at git_sha and checked equal on the synthetic split.

what_is_rated: verdict label + one reason + the 'what to do now' actions, as the shipped catalog renders them (template-only text)
